$note: 第 3 層 · 六十星系（2026-10-12）：太陰太陽坐丑未，《深造講義》p.184。

basis.quote: 便须分别其为开朗，抑为沈郁

rules.text: 你的日月在未，太陽得地，比在丑宮優勝。
rules.en: Your Sun and Moon sit in Wei, where the Sun has ground, which is better than in Chou.

source.quote: 未宫的[曰月]又优于丑宫

rules.text: 你的日月在丑，太陽落陷，解不了天梁的孤忌。
rules.en: Your Sun and Moon sit in Chou, where the Sun is weak and can't lift Tian Liang's isolation.

rules.text: 你的太陽吉化，光華增加，形成開朗的性質。
rules.en: Your Sun has a favourable transformation, adding brightness and an open disposition.

source.quote: 然后始可以形成开朗的性质

rules.text: 你的太陰吉化，只是減少太陰本身的沉潛收斂。
rules.en: Your Moon has a favourable transformation, which only lessens the Moon's own withdrawn reserve.

source.quote: 减少了太阴本身的沈潜收敛之性而已

rules.text: 你的太陽化忌，孤忌之性加強：外表難以捉摸，內心的苦也不足為外人道。
rules.en: Your Sun is transformed by Ji, strengthening the isolation: hard to read on the outside, with private pain you don't share.

rules.text: 有吉星會合，增加你的開朗。
rules.en: Favourable stars meeting your chart add to your openness.
